description: Master Django's template language, inheritance, and static files

slides.title: Introduction to Templates
slides.content:
# Django Templates 📝 Create dynamic HTML pages with Django's template language! ## What you'll learn: - **Template Basics** - Variables and tags - **Template Inheritance** - Reusable layouts - **Filters** - Transform displayed data - **Static Files** - CSS, JavaScript, images ## Why Templates? ```python # Without templates (messy!) def home(request): return HttpResponse(f"

{title}

...") # With templates (clean!) def home(request): return render(request, 'home.html', {'title': title}) ``` > 💡 **Templates separate presentation from logic!** This is the key to maintainable code. ## Template Location ``` myproject/ ├── templates/ # Project templates │ └── base.html └── blog/ └── templates/ # App templates └── blog/ └── list.html ```

slides.title: Template Variables
slides.content:
# Variables in Templates 📊 ## Passing Data to Templates ```python # views.py def article_detail(request, pk): article = Article.objects.get(pk=pk) return render(request, 'article.html', { 'article': article, 'author': article.author, 'tags': ['python', 'django'], }) ``` ## Displaying Variables ```html

{{ article.title }}

By {{ author.name }}

{{ article.content }}

{{ user.email }} {{ article.published_date }} {{ tags.0 }} ``` ## Variable Fallbacks ```html {{ name|default:"Anonymous" }} {% if article.image %} {% endif %} ``` > 💡 **Dot notation** accesses attributes, methods, dictionary keys, and list indices!

slides.title: Template Tags
slides.content:
# Template Tags 🏷️ Tags provide logic in templates using `{% tag %}`. ## If/Else Statements ```html {% if user.is_authenticated %}

Welcome, {{ user.username }}!

{% elif user.is_guest %}

Welcome, Guest!

{% else %}

Please log in

{% endif %} ``` ## For Loops ```html
    {% for article in articles %}
  • {{ article.title }}
    • {% empty %}
  • No articles yet.
    • {% endfor %}
``` ## Loop Variables ```html {% for item in items %} {{ forloop.counter }} {{ forloop.counter0 }} {{ forloop.first }} {{ forloop.last }} {% endfor %} ``` ## URL Tag ```html Read More Home ```

slides.title: Template Filters
slides.content:
# Template Filters 🔧

Transform variables with filters using `|`.

## Text Filters

```html
{{ name|upper }}          <!-- JOHN -->
{{ name|lower }}          <!-- john -->
{{ name|title }}          <!-- John Doe -->
{{ text|truncatewords:30 }} <!-- First 30 words... -->
{{ text|truncatechars:100 }} <!-- First 100 chars... -->
{{ text|wordcount }}      <!-- Number of words -->
```

## Date Filters

```html
{{ date|date:"F j, Y" }}  <!-- March 15, 2024 -->
{{ date|date:"d/m/Y" }}   <!-- 15/03/2024 -->
{{ date|timesince }}      <!-- 2 days ago -->
```

## List/Number Filters

```html
{{ items|length }}        <!-- 5 -->
{{ items|first }}         <!-- First item -->
{{ items|last }}          <!-- Last item -->
{{ items|join:", " }}     <!-- item1, item2, item3 -->
{{ number|add:5 }}        <!-- number + 5 -->
```

## Safety Filters

```html
{{ html_content|safe }}   <!-- Render as HTML -->
{{ text|escape }}         <!-- Escape HTML -->
{{ text|striptags }}      <!-- Remove HTML tags -->
```

> ⚠️ **Only use `|safe` with trusted content!** It can cause XSS vulnerabilities.

slides.title: Template Inheritance
slides.content:
# Template Inheritance 🏗️ Create reusable layouts with base templates! ## Base Template ```html {% block title %}My Site{% endblock %} {% block extra_css %}{% endblock %}
Home About
{% block content %} {% endblock %}
© 2024 My Site
{% block extra_js %}{% endblock %} ``` ## Child Template ```html {% extends 'base.html' %} {% block title %}Home - My Site{% endblock %} {% block content %}

Welcome!

This is the home page.

{% endblock %} ``` > 💡 **DRY Principle:** Define your layout once, reuse everywhere!

slides.title: Including Templates
slides.content:
# Include and Block Tags 📦 ## Including Partial Templates ```html
Home About
{% include 'includes/navbar.html' %} {% block content %}{% endblock %} ``` ## Include with Variables ```html {% include 'card.html' with title=article.title %}

{{ title }}

``` ## Block Super ```html {% block sidebar %}

Default Sidebar

{% endblock %} {% block sidebar %} {{ block.super }}

Extra Content

{% endblock %} ``` > 🎯 **Use `include` for reusable components like cards, modals, alerts!**

slides.title: Static Files
slides.content: # Static Files 📁 Serve CSS, JavaScript, and images. ## Configure Static Files ```python # settings.py STATIC_URL = '/static/' STATICFILES_DIRS = [ BASE_DIR / 'static', ] STATIC_ROOT = BASE_DIR / 'staticfiles' # For production ``` ## Directory Structure ``` myproject/ ├── static/ # Project-wide static │ ├── css/ │ │ └── style.css │ ├── js/ │ │ └── main.js │ └── images/ │ └── logo.png └── blog/ └── static/ # App static └── blog/ └── css/ └── blog.css ``` ## Using Static Files in Templates ```html {% load static %} ``` > ⚠️ **Don't forget `{% load static %}` at the top of your template!**

slides.title: Summary
slides.content:
# Excellent Work! 🎉

You've mastered Django Templates!

## Template Basics
- ✅ Variables: `{{ variable }}`
- ✅ Tags: `{% tag %}`
- ✅ Filters: `{{ var|filter }}`

## Template Logic
- ✅ `{% if %}` / `{% elif %}` / `{% else %}`
- ✅ `{% for %}` loops with `{% empty %}`
- ✅ Loop variables (`forloop.counter`, etc.)

## Template Inheritance
- ✅ `{% extends 'base.html' %}`
- ✅ `{% block name %}` / `{% endblock %}`
- ✅ `{% include 'partial.html' %}`
- ✅ `{{ block.super }}`

## Static Files
- ✅ `{% load static %}`
- ✅ `{% static 'path/to/file' %}`
- ✅ Static file configuration

## Common Filters
- ✅ Text: `upper`, `lower`, `truncatewords`
- ✅ Dates: `date`, `timesince`
- ✅ Lists: `length`, `first`, `join`

> 🚀 **Next Steps:** Learn about Models to work with databases!
